updates.reason: Correct the false implication that the May 27 BNetzA interim position finalized a blanket fee exemption, resolved retroactivity, or demonstrated recovered investment confidence; preserve the May event and all existing identity/taxonomy/Related fields.
updates.evidence_review_summary: BNetzA May 27 release (Erzeuger/Betreiber von Stromspeichern/Dynamische Netzentgelte) and slides 49 and 57-60 substantiate conditional projected capacity funding tariff, distinct dynamic tariff, and no funding work charge. BNetzA May briefing event page Fall 1/Fall 2 explicitly distinguishes already operating §118(6)-exempt storage from uncommissioned storage requiring both pre-effective FID and commissioning by 2029-08-04. The Energy-Storage.News shorthand is removed as legal authority; original Modo URL is retained only for its modelled 2030 four-hour 0.5 pp sensitivity (visible publication May 28). November StromVKG FAQ is later context and not attributed to May. No formal-run claim.
